title: Void Starsea
text: An underground ocean fills this region of the spatial caverns. Rough spatial crystal forms the seabed; sparse islands are made from excited crystal. Fallen luminous stars are partly buried below, and some large cores contain a treasure orb.
Neutral Star Jellyfish and Void Mantas inhabit the sea. Riding a manta protects against starflow, but not against fissures.
